thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow at 09:00 PT. I'll create release/1.16 from origin/main unless anyone objects. Need branch owner(s) and any PRs that must be exempted from the cut.

mike: I can own the cut and initial smoke tests.

sasha: Are docs-only changes allowed to skip backports, or do we still need an explicit skip label?

elaine: Docs-only can skip backports. Please add [docs-only] to the PR title and comment. Any data migrations or infra churn should be called out — those will be considered exemptions.

elaine: Branch command I'll run (so ops can mirror):
```
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
git push origin release/1.16
```

dev-bot: branch protection checks: no conflicts detected on origin/main at 2024-06-18T22:00:00Z. CI will run post-push.

karen: Filed a cherry-pick request for #8245 (timeout fix). This is runtime-affecting — needs backport to 1.15 and 1.16. PTAL.

elaine: Got it. Backport rules recap: security and stability fixes are eligible. Non-critical features or refactors get deferred to the next minor. For each cherry-pick, use the backport template: original PR link, rationale, test plan, and target branches.

raj: I'll review the #8245 cherry-pick this afternoon. Ping me if the CI shows flaky tests — happy to rerun.

tomas: Quick question — does the release CI require us to register the new branch in release-ci.yml before the cut, or can post-cut registration work?

elaine: We can register post-cut but it's cleaner to add the entry immediately after the push. I'll add a changelog entry and the release-ci line after creation. @release-admin can you auto-register branches on push?

release-admin: Auto-register enabled for release/* on push — will create a release pipeline if that pattern matches.

karen: Can we get a short post-cut checklist? I want to hand off jobs and alert on-call.

elaine: Post-cut checklist (short): smoke tests pass, important jobs handoff, changelog PR tagged, cherry-pick queue triaged, alert on-call if any job regressions. I'll post a checklist doc in #eng-releases after the cut.

mike: Sounds good — will be online at 08:30 PT to watch the cut. :thumbsup:
